toolchain.name: Mirah complete JVM compiler
toolchain.manifest:
Manifest-Version: 1.0
Ant-Version: Apache Ant 1.8.2
Created-By: 1.8.0_101-b13 (Oracle Corporation)
Main-Class: org.mirah.MirahCommand

semantic_scope: The original Mirah source was compiled by Mirah and its generated JVM class printed exactly Hello, World! plus LF. No Ruby substitution or GUI was used.
checker_correction: The original hello.mirah compiles to HelloTopLevel.class in Mirah0.2.1. The old README expected Hello, and the first checker looked for that name. The successful run invokes the actual generated main class. The original source is unchanged. Java21 failure and the isolated Java8 retry are retained.

selected_environment_metadata_provenance.scope: Added only explicitly configured PATH/build flags from the executed runner; command text, source hashes and actual outputs are unchanged.

path_normalization: The checkout and user profile prefixes were normalized for publication; captured output and checked source hashes are retained.
test_scope_description: The original Mirah source was compiled by Mirah and its generated JVM class printed exactly Hello, World! plus LF. No Ruby substitution or GUI was used.
